title: One board at a time
lede: Click any board's name to open it on its own: a larger drawing that stays pinned while you scroll its zones, layouts you can switch between, filters, and arrow keys to move to the next board.

sections.heading: After only
sections.note: This is a new view, so there's no before. Chromium at 1440 × 1000 and 390 × 844, light mode, manifest 2026-10-08.2.

shots.title: North Board
shots.cap: Opened from the card title. Layout chips (Draft) and filters with counts sit above a drawing that uses the wider page.

shots.title: Layout: Main + wings
shots.cap: Only that layout's zones are drawn and listed. The filter counts follow the layout.

shots.title: Scrolled, hovering Ad-Top Left
shots.cap: The drawing stays pinned while the list scrolls, so hovering a row always lights something you can see.

shots.title: Club Board: Pillars + center
shots.cap: The left and right ends stay blank in this layout, matching the geometry.

shots.title: West Fascia (ribbon)
shots.cap: Drawn 64 px tall and scrolled sideways instead of shrinking to 8 px. Labels sit at each zone's left edge.

shots.title: Kohl Center 360 Fascia (no positions)
shots.cap: Zones to scale on the board's own scale: Fullscreen, the 11,472 Sideline Extended pair, the 8,160 Sidelines and the 4,416 Endzone-South compare at a glance. The bars run off the right edge and scroll with the ribbon.

shots.title: Kohl Center 300 Level & Tunnels (40 zones, no positions)
shots.cap: The same chart, packed left to right. The drawing doesn't pin, since it has no zones to point at.

shots.title: Phone
shots.cap: The drawing pins under the top bar while the list scrolls.

changes.was: Every board was a card in a long venue page.
changes.now: ?d=<display id> opens a single board, from its card title, from search, or by link. ← and → step through every board.

changes.was: North Board's 26 zones were all drawn at once.
changes.now: Manifest 2026-10-08.2 adds named layouts to the North Board, Kellner and Club Board, inferred from geometry and marked draft. The build script rejects a layout zone that doesn't exist or that overlaps another.
Video, Stills only and Open issues chips with counts. A filter only appears when it would narrow the list. Filtered-out zones dim in the drawing and leave the list.

changes.was: Back left the page, and searching for an id or canvas key found nothing.
changes.now: Each view change is a history entry. Search matches ids and keys; Enter on an exact one opens the board and flashes the zone.

verification: tests/static-tools.test.ts: 47 passed (new: layout zones must exist and must not overlap)
node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs: manifest 2026-10-08.2 valid; data.js, index.json and llms.txt regenerated; boards.csv unchanged
npm run verify:docs (exit 0) and git diff --check: pass

Playwright: card title opens ?d=camp-randall/kellner; → opens South Upper Fascia; Back twice returns to Kellner, then Camp Randall; MAIN_VIDEO finds 1 row and Enter opens the North Board at main-video-fg; Enter on kohl-center/360-fascia opens it; no page errors

Playwright: after scrolling the list, clicking Main Video in the pinned drawing lands its row below the drawing (1440: row top 337 vs drawing bottom 329; 390: 237 vs 229). ← / → with focus on a chip keeps the board
Browser pane (dark mode): Kellner with the Main + ads layout renders, no console errors
notes: Layouts are a guess from geometry until someone who runs the boards confirms them. To confirm, drop draft: true from each layout in boards.json and bump the version.

Kohl Center and Field House still have no zone positions. The Board Info sheet's OLD tabs have positions for the retired KC-Ring-P / KC-Fascia-P layout, but zone names, sizes and processors differ from today's (e.g. ring sponsor 1046 vs 1056 wide), so nothing was imported. A Display Studio zone export, or screenshots of each processor's zone X/Y, would fill them in.
